label: Identity-scoped receipt: an esse-identical being receives its esse only in its essence
paraphrase: OPEN R3, identity-scoped instance of the existing unrestricted EsseReceivedOnlyInOwnEssence law: only IF esseOf x equals essenceOf x does receipt of its esse have to be in its very essence. No universal restriction on the recipients of other beings. This respects the preexisting united-soul/body scope issue in EsseReceptionDefinitionFork; it does not assert a recipient exists or make equality itself modal necessity.
